answer: Your income certificate is needed because the scheme requires a copy of the income certificate issued by the competent authority of Madhya Pradesh, signed and sealed by the authorized official of the institute [2]. This certificate helps verify that your family's annual income is below the specified limit, which is a condition for eligibility under the Mukhyamantri Medhavi Vidyarthi Yojana (MMVY) scheme.
